root_cause.text: A deadlock in the md subsystem where in-flight IO during raid456 reshape holds an active_io reference while sleeping on wait_for_reshape for progress; when reshape is frozen and a suspend is initiated via md/suspend_lo/hi, mddev_suspend() waits indefinitely for all active_io references to drain, but the reshape thread cannot progress to wake the IO, causing a circular dependency that prevents suspend from completing.
root_cause.evidence: Commit description states: "During raid456 reshape, direct IO across the reshape position can sleep in raid5_make_request() waiting for reshape progress while still holding an active_io reference. If userspace then freezes reshape and writes md/suspend_lo or md/suspend_hi, mddev_suspend() kills active_io and waits for all in-flight IO to drain. This can deadlock: the IO needs reshape progress to continue, but the reshape thread is already frozen, so the active_io reference is never dropped and suspend never completes." The patch adds a wake-up call in mddev_suspend when reshape is interrupted, mirroring the existing wake in raid5_prepare_suspend for dm-raid, to allow waiting IO to abort and drop its reference.

intent_record.intent_summary: Call the MD personality's prepare_suspend callback during device suspend if reshape is already interrupted, to wake any waiters holding active_io references and prevent a suspend deadlock.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional call to mddev->pers->prepare_suspend(mddev) in mddev_suspend after percpu_ref_kill, provided mddev->pers and its prepare_suspend method exist and reshape_interrupted(mddev) is true.
intent_record.how: During suspend, if the reshape operation was previously interrupted, the personality's prepare_suspend callback is invoked to wake threads that may be sleeping in wait_for_reshape while holding an active_io reference, allowing them to abort and drop the reference so that suspend can complete without deadlock.

grouping_result.intent: Call the MD personality's prepare_suspend callback during device suspend if reshape is already interrupted, to wake any waiters holding active_io references and prevent a suspend deadlock.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the deadlock by introducing a prepare_suspend callback to wake waiters holding active_io references during suspend, which is the exact circular dependency described in the root cause.

candidates.rationale: This wait in mddev_suspend() waits indefinitely for active_io to drain, but the reshape thread (holding an active_io reference) cannot progress because it is sleeping on wait_for_reshape, creating a deadlock. The fix adds a prepare_suspend callback before this wait to wake the reshape thread.

vuln_statements.explanation: This wait in mddev_suspend() blocks indefinitely for all active_io references to drain. During raid456 reshape, in-flight IO holds an active_io reference while sleeping on wait_for_reshape, preventing progress and creating a deadlock when suspend is requested.
